columns.name: SOURCE_TABLE

columns.description: Identifier a transaction source.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_OVERLAY_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of account overlay source.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERCOMPANY_REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this line is an intercompany reversal line.

columns.name: OVERRIDDEN_CODE_COMBINATION_ID

columns.description: Reason to override journal entry.
